**Business Domain:**
Time Series Data Analysis for Activity Recognition

**Business Scenario:**
An enterprise-level sports analytics company is developing a sophisticated platform for time series data analysis to monitor and evaluate athletic performance. This platform aims to collect and analyze sensor data from athletes to identify different types of activities and assess performance metrics. Each athlete wears a set of sensors that capture a variety of measurements, such as acceleration, gyroscope readings, and other biomechanical data, at high frequencies during training sessions or competitions.

The platform must support real-time data collection and provide tools for both historical analysis and predictive analytics. It should allow coaches and sports scientists to monitor the athletes' performance, compare it against historical data, and identify patterns or anomalies that could indicate areas for improvement or risk of injury. Advanced machine learning algorithms will be employed to classify activities and evaluate performance metrics, such as peak performance, variance, and standard deviation.

The system must efficiently handle complex data structures with numerous features (e.g., averages, peak values, MFCC coefficients) and provide a user-friendly interface for data visualization and reporting. It should also incorporate a robust user management system to control access to sensitive athlete data, allowing different levels of permissions for coaches, analysts, and athletes themselves.

Additionally, the platform should facilitate collaboration among different teams, enabling data sharing and collective analysis while ensuring data integrity and security.
